dispositions.reason: Checked src/invoices.js: new invoices are created with payments: [] only, so the plan's claim that every invoice has refunds[] after migration is wrong; the plan must also initialise refunds and refundKeys in createInvoice (and declare that edit in Files) or have refundInvoice default them.

Step 5 uses parseFloat, dollars and toFixed, which breaks the SPEC money constraint and the README no-floating-point rule; the plan must parse with parseMinor, compare in integer minor units and format only through formatMinor.

Checked test/store.test.js: the version-1 case asserts schemaVersion 2, which fails once SCHEMA_VERSION is 3; step 2 must say to update that assertion (to 3, plus refunds/refundKeys defaults) instead of keeping the case unchanged.

SPEC scope names listing an invoice's refunds but AC-1..AC-7 never call the GET route, so the plan has no planned test for it; add a planned test for listing (org scoping, order, role) and declare its test file in Files.

The SPEC sets no role for listing and the plan exposes actor key ids and reasons to members, unlike the admin-only audit and key endpoints; the plan should restrict listing to admins (or drop actor from the member view) and state the choice, since it cannot be told the SPEC intends otherwise.

Step 7 silently returns 200 with the original refund when a key is replayed with a different amount, which can hide a client bug and which the SPEC does not state; the plan should reject a mismatched replay (e.g. 422) or justify the choice explicitly, and escalate if it cannot decide.

The plan says a replay carries replayed: true and the route answers 200, but presentRefund has no such field and step 10 does not say how the route sees the replay or how an empty Idempotency-Key is handled; the build cannot implement this as written, so the plan must specify the return shape and empty-header rule.
The Downgrade risk cites a README upgrade line that does not exist (grep of README.md found none) and step 11 does not add one; the plan must add that README note to step 11 or drop the claim.
